notes.title: The new Demo was released on January 21st!
notes.content:
[h1]"Retrace the Light" Demo Now Available[/h1]
[list] [*]Attention all Enforcers, we have great news to announce: After several months of intensive development, the overall completion of the game "Retrace the Light" is now approaching the release stage, and we are getting closer to officially meeting you all.
[*] Therefore, we plan to release a Demo on [b]January 21st[/b], to help those who are interested in the game to take a close look at the actual gameplay experience! The Demo will be permanently available on the store page, and we will continue to update it, with no plans to take it down in the near future.

[previewyoutube=gUKhKSeJ5JE;full][/previewyoutube]
[*] This demo includes [b]the complete tutorial level and the introduction part of an official level[/b]. After completing the main storyline, which lasts about [b]40 minutes[/b], if you're still craving more, you can [b]enter the Combat Simulation Program to challenge a combat of mid-game difficulty[/b]. (Here's a secret: your opponent is your fellow Enforcer.)
[*] Compared to the full version, some growth elements such as [b]Iteration System and Booster Modules[/b] are only partially available in the Demo (including 6 Major Modules and 5 Minor Modules), and they will be automatically unlocked when entering the Combat Simulation Program. 
[*] If you encounter any issues or have suggestions while playing the Demo, feel free to share them with us in the Steam comment section. We wish you success in executing your missions in the Realm of Meta Mirror! 

[*]The Japanese, English, and Simplified Chinese localizations of the game have been implemented. If your language is not available, please don’t worry. Our localization plan is as follows: Spanish will be implemented by the end of January, and Korean, French, and Traditional Chinese will be implemented in February.
[/list]

notes.title: Celebrating [Independent Game Art Festival], the new Demo is released!
notes.content:
h2] The new Demo is now released! [/h2]

After 4 months from the first beta, we are finally excited to announce: [b] The brand new Demo is now available for everyone to download and play for free! [/b]

This demo not only installs the related functions of the booster module, but also adds a complete level including the new mechanism mechanism. The overall play time has reached more than 2.5 hours, which guarantees that everyone can play happily and comfortably!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179370/style=button]Go to the store page to download[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149099/eaacaf336f3034c68bb9c42af15ee7709e1692eb.gif[/img]

[b]This Demo contains the following elements:[/b]
 [list]
[*] Areas with different styles: pools, cliffs, artificial buildings...
[*] Located inside the statue, a challenging puzzle
[*] Horizontal board jump music session
[*] [spoiler] In order to activate a certain booster module, jump off a cliff first[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler] can't beat(?) the beetle monster[/spoiler]
[/list]
There are more interesting content in the game, please enter the game to experience it yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149099/baf00267b3d45065aaa3b4f4e19d84d02d18b6ce.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149099/653f59e5b6e9073fac941b3e2337c28b8e66ef4e.gif[/img]

[h2]GWB [Indie Game Art Festival][/h2]

GWB Independent Game Incubator is holding the [Independent Game Art Festival] special page on Steam, and selected independent games that have participated in GWB activities and have excellent quality and stylized artistic expression for special display.

"Tracing the Light" was honored to be invited, so taking advantage of the theme event, a new demo was released.

In addition, in the upcoming [b]Steam New Product Festival[/b], we will also arrange for developers to show the game content live.

If you are interested in the game after watching the live broadcast or experiencing the demo, welcome to add "Light Walk" to your wish list, and click the link below to join the group chat and share your suggestions with us!


[url=https://qm.qq.com/cgi-bin/qm/qr?k=b4jW7ylHxXQYz4SlDaxMjLtl9bpNdrnp&jump_from=webapi&authKey=g7LVHaspQXPVVfje/5SisQQF/qf8s3MTlxKLC+YYmx6NutlvwzivZ8qd6mGovCLM ] Official player exchange group: 434276599 [/url]
